inputs.prompt: Medium shot in a small modest Addis Ababa kitchen, plastered clay-coloured walls, one wooden window on the left, low wooden stool, fresh grass scattered on the floor. Emama Almaz: an Ethiopian grandmother in her late sixties, warm brown skin, oval face, soft deep smile lines, calm dark eyes, silver-grey hair parted in the centre and covered by a white cotton netela shawl with a thin woven green, gold and red border, long white handwoven habesha kemis dress, small silver stud earrings. Horizontal 16:9 composition of the same scene, main subject centred. Hand-painted gouache animation still, visible soft brush texture, gentle paper grain, muted indigo shadows and warm amber highlights, quiet intimate mood, shallow depth of field, modest Ethiopian home.
